prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-resolution nature photograph for an existing resort website.
Input image 1 is the edit target: two geese on the real Nature Nest resort lawn.
Primary request: faithfully regenerate this low-resolution photograph with clean, natural, high-resolution detail. Preserve the same animals, setting and photographic character; this is an image quality improvement, not a new scene.
Preserve exactly two geese: a mostly white goose farther back on the left, standing upright with its long neck raised and orange beak pointing right; a closer white goose on the right with soft taupe-gray wing feathers and a dark flank patch, orange legs and feet, its neck curved down in a natural preening pose. Preserve their relative positions, plausible anatomy, full bodies, feather colors and proportions.
Preserve the green lawn, neatly trimmed hedge behind the birds, small leafy trees, pale yellow building wall, black vertical metal gate and the red corrugated wall at the left. Natural sunny daylight, realistic soft ground shadows and gentle leaf shade.
Composition: portrait approximately 3:4, similar framing and viewpoint to the source, with slightly more breathing room at the right so the foreground goose fits comfortably. Keep both geese prominent in the central and lower part of the frame. Highest available resolution, ideally at least 1536 pixels on the long side.
Improve only image quality: crisp individually resolved white feathers with delicate natural shading, realistic orange feet, detailed grass blades and leaf texture, no compression artifacts, balanced highlights so white plumage retains detail, realistic greens.
Constraints: no additional birds or people; no invented architecture or amenities; no changes to the species, number of birds or their actions; no text, logos or watermark. Avoid plastic feathers, cartoon style, CGI, exaggerated saturation, artificial sharpening and distorted bird anatomy.
